body: London Heathrow is one of the world's busiest international airports, handling 83.9 million passengers and 474,029 aircraft movements in 2024, yet it remains legally capped at 480,000 annual air transport movements. Overnight, the constraint tightens further: between 11:30 p.m. and 6 a.m., the airport regulates operations with a Quota Count (QC) system rather than movement limits alone. Every aircraft is assigned a QC value based on its certificated noise performance for takeoff and landing, from QC/0 and QC/0.125 for the quietest types to QC/16 for the loudest. Aircraft rated QC/4 cannot normally operate during the night quota period, while QC/8 and QC/16 aircraft are prohibited throughout the entire night period, so a quieter aircraft lets an airline preserve more of its overnight noise allowance while keeping valuable long-haul schedules. Heathrow also charges lower noise-related landing fees for newer Chapter 14-compliant aircraft, and today more than 80% of its movements are performed by aircraft meeting ICAO Chapter 14 noise standards.

This is where the Airbus A350 has become one of the industry's standout performers. Airbus says the aircraft is up to nine decibels quieter than competing widebodies, and because sound levels multiply rather than add up, a nine-decibel drop eliminates nearly 90% of the physical noise. The A350-1000 records a certified takeoff noise level of approximately 88.8 EPNdB, and Airbus says the A350 has a noise footprint up to 50% smaller than previous-generation aircraft of a similar size. Every A350 is powered exclusively by Rolls-Royce Trent XWB engines; the larger A350-1000 uses the Trent XWB-97, producing almost 97,000 pounds of thrust, the most powerful commercial engine Rolls-Royce has ever certificated, yet among the quietest in its class thanks to acoustic optimization. The airframe helps too: more than 70% of the aircraft by weight consists of advanced materials, including 53% carbon-fiber-reinforced plastic, and its 212-foot-5-inch (64.75-meter) flexible composite wing, flap track fairings, and nacelle and wing-body integration all help minimize aerodynamic noise. The same design choices improve the cabin: the composite fuselage allows a cabin altitude of around 5,500 feet, compared with roughly 8,000 feet aboard many older widebodies, with humidity of around 20%, roughly double that of many previous-generation widebodies. British Airways has built one of Europe's largest A350-1000 fleets, operating 18 of the type on routes including New York, Washington DC, Dubai, Bengaluru, and Lagos, many departing late in the evening or arriving early in the morning. Virgin Atlantic replaced its aging Airbus A340-600 fleet with the A350-1000, cutting fuel burn and carbon emissions by around 30% while substantially reducing community noise. Airbus estimates the A350 burns around 25% less fuel and produces 25% lower CO2 emissions than previous-generation aircraft of a similar size, and airlines including Cathay Pacific, Singapore Airlines, Japan Airlines, Qatar Airways, and Finnair have likewise made the A350 a cornerstone of their Heathrow operations.
en.summary: The Airbus A350's quiet Trent XWB engines and composite airframe let airlines operate within Heathrow's strict overnight Quota Count noise limits, turning low noise into late-night scheduling flexibility that noisier widebodies cannot match.
en.title: Why the Airbus A350 can fly late-night Heathrow slots that ground competing widebodies

body: 倫敦希斯洛機場是全球最繁忙的國際機場之一，2024年處理8,390萬名旅客與474,029架次飛機起降，全年航空運輸架次卻依法上限為48萬架次。深夜的限制更為嚴格：晚上11時30分至早上6時為機場排定的夜間噪音配額時段，機場以噪音配額（QC）制度而非僅以架次上限管理營運。每架飛機依起飛與降落的認證噪音表現被賦予QC值，最安靜的機型為QC/0與QC/0.125，最吵的為QC/16；QC/4機型通常不得在夜間配額時段營運，QC/8與QC/16機型則在整個夜間時段全面禁止。因此，較安靜的飛機能讓航空公司在維持珍貴的長程航班時刻之餘，保留更多夜間噪音配額；希斯洛也對符合國際民航組織第14章噪音標準的新型飛機收取較低的噪音相關降落費，如今機場逾80%的起降架次均由符合第14章標準的飛機執行。

空中巴士A350正是在這樣的規則下脫穎而出。空中巴士表示，A350比同級廣體客機安靜最多9分貝；由於分貝以乘法而非加法累計，9分貝的差距實際上消除了近90%的物理噪音。A350-1000的認證起飛噪音約為88.8EPNdB，空中巴士表示，A350的噪音覆蓋範圍比同級前代機型小最多50%。A350全系列僅採用勞斯萊斯Trent XWB發動機，其中較大的A350-1000使用Trent XWB-97，推力近97,000磅，是勞斯萊斯認證過推力最大的商用發動機，同時也是同級中最安靜的發動機之一。機身結構同樣有助降噪：A350逾70%的重量由先進材料構成，包括53%的碳纖維強化塑膠；翼展212英尺5英寸（64.75公尺）的彈性複合材料機翼、襟翼滑軌整流罩，以及發動機短艙與翼身整合設計，都有助於降低起飛與進場時的氣動噪音。同樣的設計也改善了客艙體驗：複合材料機身使客艙高度可維持在約5,500英尺，相較許多舊型廣體客機約8,000英尺的客艙高度更低，濕度約20%，約為許多前代廣體客機的兩倍。英國航空已建立歐洲最大的A350-1000機隊之一，營運18架，飛往紐約、華盛頓、杜拜、班加羅爾、拉哥斯等多條長程航線，其中許多航班深夜出發或清晨抵達；維珍航空以A350-1000取代老舊的空中巴士A340-600機隊，油耗與碳排放減少約30%，社區噪音也大幅降低。空中巴士估計，A350比同級前代機型省油約25%、二氧化碳排放低約25%；國泰航空、新加坡航空、日本航空、卡達航空與芬蘭航空等，也都將A350作為其希斯洛營運的核心機型。
zh.summary: 空中巴士A350憑藉安靜的Trent XWB發動機與複合材料機身，得以在希斯洛嚴格的夜間噪音配額制度下營運，把低噪音轉化為深夜航班時刻的調度彈性，這是噪音較大的廣體客機無法比擬的優勢。
zh.title: 空中巴士A350憑低噪音優勢 飛進希斯洛深夜時段
